1otus.text: 1otus plays a sharp, tidy game at the summit: in the top sliver of everyone tracked, brisk tempo behind it, sustaining the output as the opposition improves. That matchup kill-death figure runs close to the top. The strongest-third share lands in the middle. A tidy game, sharp from first to last.

1os.text: 1Os is a young account with a loud opening: barely a few weeks in, and already tempo and bravery both among the very best tracked. Their resistance sits near the very top, the aim is precise, and headshots land in a strong share. Early read, but the first pages carry real weight — this one arrived playing at full speed.

187err.text: 187err is pure velocity: a top-tier work rate, nerve to match, and pace to burn, with accuracy and headshots among the best tracked. The lifetime board sits right up there with the matchups, and the kills come in a flood. The consistency mark trails below average — the only quiet note in a deafening card.

1nfinity666.text: 1nfinity666 plays a veteran's game: rating, bravery, and resistance all stand top-tier, with pace to match. Headshots land at a brisk clip and the aim remains sharp, so the kills come quick and clean. The lifetime board sits shoulder to shoulder with the matchups — a career that has held its level for years.

163roma.text: 163roma has been at this since 2015, steady as a metronome: above average on the matchup rating, tempo, bravery, resistance, and nearly every other line. Accuracy and consistency both sit mid-pack, the only ordinary notes in an otherwise strong run. A veteran regular who shows up, holds their ground, and keeps the scoreboard tilted their way.

12franco.text: 12franco has been at this since 2013, and long practice shows in the steadiness: a matchup grade firmly above the middle, calm when the fight heats up, and the exchange rate of their real fights running high. The headshot share sits below average and the career ledger reads mid-pack. A veteran who wins fights with judgment more than flash, still showing up after all these years.

10010tr.text: 10010TR fights a matchup game that the lifetime board does not flatter: above the middle in the matchups, steady under pressure, and calm when the fighting thickens. The aim sits near the bottom, the lifetime IvI line lands below the middle, and the edge slips a little against the hardest opposition. An honest regular whose best work shows up in the matchups, not the lifetime ledger.

1ryokoasakura.text: Only days into the story, and already the pace is electric: 1RyokoAsakura sits top shelf on activity, bravery, and pace, and steady as the opposition strengthens. The aim is razor-sharp, landing near the very top of the board, and the lifetime numbers back up the matchups so far. The opponent sample is small, so take this as a sketch of a fast start rather than a finished picture.

1000ggg.text: 1000GGG plays a precise, punchy game, comfortably above the middle overall. Brisk on the tempo, and calm as the opposition stiffens. The accuracy sits near the very top — the sharpest figure on the card. The head-to-head account reads middling, and the career numbers are a touch more modest. A strong regular whose shots land where they mean them to.
